title: Admin Dashboard Scope
description: The requirements define customer-facing features but lack detail on the Administrator portal's capabilities for managing inventory, viewing analytics, or handling order fulfillment workflows.
impact: Determines the scope of the administrative backend development effort.

title: Product Image and Media Management
description: There is no definition of how product media (images, videos, 360-degree views) will be stored, served, or optimized across web and mobile platforms.
impact: Affects infrastructure requirements, bandwidth costs, and front-end performance implementation.

title: Inventory Synchronization Logic
description: There is no business rule defined for inventory handling, specifically regarding overselling, safety stock levels, or how real-time stock updates from the ERP are reflected on the frontend.
impact: Critical for business rules and core functionality to prevent inconsistent stock status.

title: Mobile Platform Strategy
description: It is not specified whether the mobile app should be native (Swift/Kotlin), cross-platform (Flutter/React Native), or a Progressive Web App (PWA).
impact: Significantly impacts development effort, budget, and long-term maintenance strategy.

title: Payment Gateway Region/Configuration
description: The requirement specifies Razorpay but does not define the currencies, regions, or specific payment methods (e.g., UPI, NetBanking, Wallets) required beyond credit cards.
impact: Affects the configuration complexity of the Razorpay integration and user checkout flow.

title: ERP API Specification
description: The specific ERP system being used is not defined, nor is there a definition of the data schema or communication protocol expected for the integration.
impact: Architectural design and development effort for data synchronization cannot be finalized without knowing the target ERP API requirements.

title: Mobile Application Target Platforms
description: The client requested a mobile store but did not specify if the cross-platform application should target iOS, Android, or both.
impact: Determines the build environment, testing strategy, and developer account requirements.

title: Guest Checkout Data Migration/Linking
description: Client confirmed guest checkout is required, but did not define the technical requirement for linking a guest's purchase history to a future account registration.
impact: Influences user account database design and order history synchronization logic.

title: Safety Stock Threshold Behavior
description: Client requested safety stock functionality but did not define the exact system behavior when the threshold is reached (e.g., disable 'Add to Cart' button, display 'Out of Stock' label, or prevent checkout).
impact: Directly impacts the purchase flow and user experience regarding item availability.

title: TaxJar Configuration for Multi-Currency/Language
description: Client requires multi-language and multi-currency support, but has not defined how TaxJar should handle tax calculations for regions outside the primary currency (INR).
impact: Affects the configuration and accuracy of tax calculations in international markets.

title: Push Notification Provider Selection
description: Client requested both SMS and Email (via AWS), but push notifications for the mobile application were mentioned as a requirement without a specified provider or integration strategy.
impact: Impacts the implementation effort for the mobile engagement strategy.

title: ERP Synchronization Error Handling
description: While the client confirmed ERP as the source of truth for stock, the system lacks a defined strategy for handling synchronization conflicts, timeouts, or data latency issues between the storefront and the ERP.
impact: Potential for overselling or incorrect inventory visibility during high-traffic periods.
